title: design: module placement + throughput checkpoint
description: Decide file locations (SourceStack.tsx, DitherAvatarRoster.tsx under features/chat/, optional prompt-kit source under components/prompt-kit/, dither-kit under components/dither-kit/), data flow (ChatTimeline computes sources via parseWebSearchResults + webCitationsFromToolCalls, avatars via collectSubagentRunsFromTimeline), and write 4-dim throughput checkpoint notes.
notes:
Module placement:
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/SourceStack.tsx (new) - typed StackedSource, cascade UI, no external deps, optional prompt-kit re-export if installed
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/DitherAvatarRoster.tsx (new) - hue hashing, motion while running, fallback pixel if dither-kit not installed
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/condensedHeader.ts (optional pure helper) - collectWebSourcesFromTurn, shouldHideToolInCondensed, filterToolsForCondensed
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/ChatTimeline.tsx (modify) - compute sources+avatars at top of AssistantTurnBubble, render header strip before groups, filter tools groups when header non-empty
- portal/packages/web/src/features/chat/ChatView.tsx (modify if needed) - ensure onSubagentSelect wiring remains (already exists)
- Optional: portal/packages/web/components.json + portal/packages/web/components/dither-kit/avatar.tsx installed via npx @dither-kit/cli add avatar (requires components.json + tailwind), plus portal/packages/web/src/components/prompt-kit/source.tsx if prompt-kit installed
- Styles: chat.css for cascade overlap and avatar pulse

Data flow:
  BFF SSE -> useChatEvents -> ChatTimelineToolCall[] -> AssistantTurnBubble: collectSubagentRunsFromTimeline (already) + new collectStackedSources (via parseWebSearchResults deduped) -> header strip [SourceStack | DitherAvatarRoster] -> filtered renderGroups -> remaining ChatToolCalls/subagent chips/workflows

Throughput checkpoint (feature step 3):
- Blocking first steps: install/config dither-kit + prompt-kit (or stub) and create components.json before coding header; research bead already done.
- Independent workstreams: SourceStack file vs DitherAvatarRoster file vs ChatTimeline integration vs css/proof-story — first two are disjoint files (parallelizable), integration serializes on those files landing.
- Shared mutable state: ChatTimeline.tsx is single shared writer for header + filtering; per principle separate-before-serializing, keep SourceStack and Roster as separate components but serialize final ChatTimeline edit (one owner). No other file needs locking.
- Smallest safe decomposition: one worker best (single shared ChatTimeline.tsx writer + small new files); parallelizing across workers would collide on same file and cause merge conflicts. Keep sequential within one implementer, review separation via delegate.
close_reason: Module placement + throughput checkpoint captured: 2 new components under features/chat/, helpers, ChatTimeline integration, optional dither-kit/prompt-kit installs, css. Checkpoint: blocking installs, independent SourceStack vs Roster files, serialize ChatTimeline edit, single owner best.

title: design: condensed tool-call hiding + grouping rules
description: Define when to hide noisy rows: helper-agent delegate/spawn_subagent subagent kind and web_search/browse generic tools are summarized in header; generic tools group excludes those when header present. Document filter rules and fallback to plain rows when no header.
notes: Condensed hiding rules: If header has sources or avatars, filter generic tools group: exclude calls where isWebSearchToolName||isWebBrowseToolName (they are represented by SourceStack) and where call.kind===subagent (represented by avatars). If after filtering tools group becomes empty, skip rendering that ChatToolCalls group (avoid duplicate rows). Helper-agent technicalName hiding stays via resolveChatToolCallDisplay (technical id in advanced detail only). When header absent (no web/subagent), fall back to existing ChatToolCalls rendering unchanged (backward compat). Also keep workflow cards separate (not hidden). Edge: if user asks no web/subagent, header not shown, no filtering.
close_reason: Condensed hiding rules captured: web_search/browse + subagent kinds moved to header, filtered from generic ChatToolCalls, empty groups skipped, no change when header absent.

title: design: DitherAvatarRoster spec (animated, hue per agent, click->sidebar)

notes: DitherAvatarRoster design: props { runs: SubagentRun[], onSelect(run), onOpenRoster? }. Hue: hash(name)->0..360 (or use subagentColor hex -> hsl conversion). While running: motion pulse (scale 0.95-1.05, 1.2s loop, opacity breathing). Use dither-kit <DitherAvatar name hue> if installed under portal/packages/web/components/dither-kit/avatar.tsx + core; fallback minimal pixel avatar (canvas div with pattern) if not available to avoid hard dep. Distinct color per run via hue spread. Click: onSelect -> handleSubagentSelect in ChatView (dispatches SIDE_PANE_OPEN_ACTIVITY). Also show +N if >5. Placement: same header strip right-aligned vs SourceStack left, or unified row: [Source stack | spacer | Avatar roster]. Streaming: collectSubagentRunsFromTimeline recomputed each render, avatars appear as soon as delegate_to_subagent event arrives.
close_reason: DitherAvatarRoster spec captured: hue per name, motion pulse while running, click->SIDE_PANE_OPEN_ACTIVITY, fallback if dither-kit not installed, same header strip.

title: design: SourceStack spec (cascade, favicon, +N, streaming)
description: Spec SourceStack component: props StackedSource {url,title,description,favicon,provider}, max=4 cascading overlap, favicon via showFavicon or https://www.google.com/s2/favicons, hover preview card, placed on top of tool calls (not end), incremental streaming as web_search results arrive. Reuse prompt-kit Source API if available else minimal implementation.
notes: SourceStack design: props { sources: StackedSource[] (url,title,description,provider), max=4, onOpen?(url) }. Cascade: overlapping icons with -8px margin, z-index descending, +N overflow badge. Each icon shows favicon via https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=host or prompt-kit SourceTrigger showFavicon. Hover: prompt-kit SourceContent card (title+description) or custom popover. Aggregation: in AssistantTurnBubble, collectWebSourcesFromTurn(item): iterate tool calls where isWebSearchToolName||isWebBrowseToolName, parseWebSearchResults per call, dedupe by url, slice max 4, update incrementally while streaming. Placement: header strip rendered BEFORE renderGroups.map, so appears on top of tool calls while anyToolRunning; persists after done (dimmed). Styling: flex row, gap-2, stack container flex with overlap.
close_reason: SourceStack spec captured: cascading 4 max, favicon via S2, hover card, placement on top of tools, incremental streaming aggregation via parseWebSearchResults deduped.

## Architect Phase A: Grounding (how)

**Subsystem:** ChatTimeline -> groupSegmentsForRender -> ChatToolCalls / SubagentRunChip / WorkflowCard + ReasoningBlock ; ChatView -> activityPane reducer + DocumentPaneHost ; webCitations parseWebSearchResults -> WebSearchResultsList

**Flow:** BFF SSE (GET /api/chat/threads/:id/events) -> useChatEvents hook builds ChatTimelineToolCall + segments (SoT) ordered by wire arrival -> AssistantTurnBubble resolveTurnSegments + groupSegmentsForRender -> ChatMessageBubble stack (first/middle/last). Subagent detection via isSubagentEvent (tool_kind=subagent, subagent_name, portal_event), Workflow via isWorkflowEvent. Web tool detection via bareToolNameKey + WEB_SEARCH_EXACT/BROWSE_EXACT (webCitations.ts). Generic tools coalesced, subagent/workflow break out individually.

**Layering ownership:** portal/packages/web/src/features/chat owns display mappers; hooks/useChatEvents owns state assembly; activityPane/* owns side-pane state machine; documentPane/* shares column. New condensed header belongs in AssistantTurnBubble inside ChatTimeline.tsx, not ChatView, to stay turn-local and stream live.

**Principles applied:** model the domain (StackedSource, AvatarRun typed models), boundary discipline (parse at webCitations boundary, pure mappers), laziness protocol (smallest change: header strip + filter, no new global state), experience first (delight over raw tool dump).
